message:
Here is your current brief, unchanged, plus the two saved homes.

**Your requirements (as currently recorded)**
- Rent ceiling: £2,000 per month (separate from the combined limit)
- Rent plus commuting ceiling: £2,150 per month
- Office days: 2 per week (Tuesday and Thursday)
- Home type: self-contained whole one-bedroom flat
- Areas: Lewisham or Stratford
- Commute: public transport to Bank station, about 45 minutes or less

**The two saved homes (recorded details, not live-verified)**
1. Bonfield Road, London, SE13 — £1875 pcm, 1 bed flat, unverified). https://www.onthemarket.com/details/20567130/
2. Unex Tower, 7 Station Street, London, E15 — £2300 pcm, 1 bed flat, https://www.onthemarket.com/details/14951549/

**Which to contact first**
Bonfield Road. It is the only one of the two that fits your £2,000 rent cap; Unex Tower is £300 over it and its rent alone already exceeds your £2,150 combined ceiling, so it cannot work under your current numbers unless the asking rent drops or you change the limits. Bonfield Road is also in Lewisham, one of your two target areas.

**What still needs checking before you commit**
- Bonfield Road: not a measured TfL journey — get a real itinerary timed. Confirm the rent and availability are current, and confirm it is a self-contained whole flat (the snapshot shows "1 bed Flat" but I have not verified the whole-flat/self-contained status).
- Bonfield Road: verify the monthly travel cost to Bank at two days a week, so the rent-plus-commute total can be checked against £2,150.
- Unex Tower: confirm the current asking rent — at £2,300 it fails both ceilings.
- Both: cached prices and availability may have changed; confirm with the agent.

I have not changed your search or your saved homes.

Note: some commute claims could not be verified and have been removed from this answer.
